role: Falling-block and hanging-entity probe: plays a generated script of sand, gravel, anvil and dragon-egg falls and painting and item-frame placements over a raw region, ticking scheduled updates and its entity list the way the server does and recording every stream.
used_by: oracle/Makefile run target (make run CLASS=FallHangProbe), dispatched by Oracle.java's {"cmd":"run","class":...}
notes: Uses EntityProbe's entity tick and Det-state helpers. Every EntityItem spawned is recorded in itemdrops.bin and removed at once, never ticked. No oracle/src file calls into it (grep of oracle/src for the class name); used_by paths under out/java were listed, not opened.
